2610.13510.title: Retrieval-Augmented Multimodal Language Model with Heterogeneous Evidence Integration for Clinical Prognosis
2610.13510.paper_summary: Clinical prognosis requires integrating structured measurements, physiological waveforms, longitudinal history, and population context. We introduce PRISM (Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis), a multimodal language model that combines per-feature numerical tokenization, recency-weighted aggregation of longitudinal ECGs, and a dual-modality population memory bank. Retrieval operates in representation space: the model receives mean-pooled embeddings of similar training-cohort encounters, while no individual retrieved record enters the prompt. On the 1,443-task MDS-ED benchmark, PRISM achieves AUROCs of 86.2% for diagnosis, 93.1% for deterioration, 91.8% for ICU admission, and 92.8% for mortality. These results use a 96-hour pre-arrival window unavailable to reported baselines. With benchmark-window inputs only, PRISM reaches 0.8895 AUROC, compared with 0.8937 for UniPACT and 0.8889 for MDS-ED. A matched-input compact fusion model using the same five evidence streams and frozen encoders reaches 0.7652 AUROC, versus 0.9092 for PRISM. Replacing numerical EHR encoding with text serialization reduces AUROC by 3.66 points; removing pre-arrival history reduces it by 1.97 points; and zeroing retrieval reduces it by 0.99 points. Genuine retrieval outperforms random-neighbor retrieval by 0.97 macro-average points, although a paired task-level sign test does not establish a uniform advantage (p=0.067). On the external MC-MED cohort, supervised fine-tuning reaches 0.8611 AUROC, compared with 0.8227 for locally trained gradient boosting and 0.7841 for source-only PRISM. These results support structure-aware multimodal integration and supervised external adaptation.
2610.13510.paper_summary_zh: 臨床預後需要整合結構化測量、生理波形、縱向歷史和人口背景。我們介紹了PRISM（Population-Retrieved Inference for Structured Multimodal Prognosis），這是一種多模態語言模型，結合了每個特徵的數值標記、對縱向心電圖的近期加權聚合，以及雙模態的人口記憶庫。檢索在表示空間中運作：模型接收相似訓練隊列遭遇的均值池嵌入，而沒有任何單獨檢索的記錄進入提示。在1,443任務的MDS-ED基準上，PRISM在診斷方面達到86.2%的AUROC，在惡化方面達到93.1%，在ICU入院方面達到91.8%，在死亡率方面達到92.8%。這些結果使用了96小時的到達前窗口，這在報告的基準中不可用。僅使用基準窗口輸入，PRISM達到0.8895的AUROC，而UniPACT為0.8937，MDS-ED為0.8889。使用相同五個證據流和凍結編碼器的匹配輸入緊湊融合模型達到0.7652的AUROC，而PRISM則為0.9092。將數值EHR編碼替換為文本序列化使AUROC降低了3.66點；去除到達前歷史使其降低了1.97點；而將檢索歸零使其降低了0.99點。真實檢索的表現超過隨機鄰居檢索0.97的宏平均點，儘管配對任務級別的符號檢驗並未確立一致的優勢（p=0.067）。在外部MC-MED隊列上，監督微調達到0.8611的AUROC，而本地訓練的梯度提升為0.8227，僅源PRISM為0.7841。這些結果支持結構感知的多模態整合和監督外部適應。
